forecast.basis: Both rosters as they stand entering Monday (your streaming spot included), each team starting its best players every day. Next week's streaming is not counted.

injuries.name: Giannis Antetokounmpo
injuries.comment: Antetokounmpo is probable for Friday's game against the Knicks due to right groin tendinitis.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.comment: Irving (knee) is listed as questionable for Friday's game against the Suns due to left knee injury management.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.comment: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
